title: Peds Proton Therapy
official: Operational and Clinical Evaluation of the Treatment Planning Software and Oncology Information System for Pediatric Proton Therapy
summary: This study is being done to evaluate the clinical utilization and safety of RayStation 2025 and RayCare 2025 treatment planning software upgrades when used to support standard-of-care proton therapy delivery in patients deemed clinically appropriate for such therapy by their treating radiation oncologist.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age less than or equal to 17 years at the time of consent/assent.
* Patient has a clinical indication for radiation therapy, and the treating radiation oncologist has independently determined that proton therapy is clinically appropriate and has recommended proton therapy as part of the patient's routine clinical care, independent of participation in this research study. Proton therapy may be delivered with or without anesthesia when clinically indicated.
* Written informed consent will be obtained from adult subjects or the parent/legal guardian of pediatric subjects. Assent will be obtained from pediatric participants when appropriate according to institutional policy.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient has contraindications to proton therapy (per standard clinical guidelines).
* Patient is unable to comply with routine treatment workflow or follow-up.
* Patients who will be treated with a radiation plan of 5 fractions or fewer.
